slides.texte_overlay:
4 habits that keep you stuck
in autopilot

(and how to wake up again)

1. you take the same route
every day

change one street.
notice something new.

2. you eat the same five meals

cook one new recipe a week.

3. you have the same
conversations

ask a question you've
never asked.

4. you stopped learning

five minutes of something new
wakes your brain up.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. you stopped learning

use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
you don't escape autopilot
in one day.

you escape it one small
choice at a time.
